act.name: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing arbitration agreements, proceedings, interim relief and enforcement of arbitral awards.

sections.title: Interim measures, etc., by Court.
sections.text: Section 9 provides for applications to court for interim measures connected with arbitration.
sections.plain_language_summary: A party may seek specified interim protection from a court before or during arbitration and in the period allowed after an award.
